description: Defines the class f1u_bearer_impl implementing bearer handling, including PDU and SDU processing, timers, and metrics within the ocudu::ocuup namespace.

classes.name: f1u_bearer_impl
classes.description: Final class implementing f1u_bearer, f1u_rx_pdu_handler, and f1u_tx_sdu_handler, managing bearer lifecycle, PDU/SDU handling, timers, and metrics.

methods.name: f1u_bearer_impl
methods.description: Constructor initializing the bearer with necessary parameters and dependencies.

methods.name: ~f1u_bearer_impl
methods.description: Destructor that calls stop() to clean up resources.

methods.name: get_rx_pdu_handler
methods.description: Returns reference to self as rx_pdu_handler.

methods.name: get_tx_sdu_handler
methods.description: Returns reference to self as tx_sdu_handler.

methods.name: stop
methods.description: Stops the bearer, sets stopped flag, and stops the downlink notification timer.

methods.name: handle_sdu
methods.description: Handles incoming SDU data, with indication if retransmission.

methods.name: discard_sdu
methods.description: Discards SDU with specified PDCP SN.

methods.name: get_ul_tnl_info
methods.description: Returns the UL transport layer info assigned at construction.

methods.name: get_ul_teid
methods.description: Returns the UL TEID associated with this bearer.

methods.name: handle_pdu_impl
methods.description: Internal implementation for handling PDU messages.

methods.name: fill_discard_blocks
methods.description: Fills a message with aggregated SDU discard blocks.

methods.name: flush_discard_blocks
methods.description: Immediately transmits aggregated SDU discard blocks.
